features.lag1: yesterday's evening kWh (NaN if yesterday is not a valid household-day)
features.lag7: same weekday last week, evening kWh (NaN if missing)
features.last_value: most recent valid evening kWh on or before D-1 (never NaN once any history exists)
features.gap_days: calendar days between D and that most recent valid evening (1 = yesterday)
features.roll7_median: median evening kWh over the 7 calendar days D-7..D-1 (observed days only)
features.roll28_median: median evening kWh over D-28..D-1: the household's recent level
features.roll28_iqr: p75-p25 of the same window: how variable the household has been
features.roll28_frac_zero: share of observed evenings in D-28..D-1 that are exactly 0 kWh
features.roll7_n: number of observed evenings in D-7..D-1 (0-7): recent coverage
features.roll28_n: number of observed evenings in D-28..D-1 (0-28): history depth
features.expanding_median: median of every valid evening the household has up to D-1: long-run level
features.dow: day of week of D (0 = Monday); known in advance
features.is_weekend: 1 if D is Saturday or Sunday; known in advance
features.month: calendar month of D; known in advance

baselines.global_median: constant: median of the TRAINING targets
baselines.persistence_lag1: yesterday's evening value (only where yesterday exists)
baselines.persistence_last: last observed evening value, carried forward over gaps
baselines.seasonal_lag7: same weekday last week (only where it exists)
baselines.roll7_median: median of the last 7 calendar days' observed evenings
baselines.roll28_median: median of the last 28 calendar days' observed evenings
baselines.expanding_median: median of all of the household's past evenings
